title: Prusa i3 MK3S+ Hotend Repair
subtitle: My beloved 3D printer refused to print, beeped aggressively, and threw the wonderfully unhelpful error: "Some problem encountered."
description: The culprit was a frayed heater cartridge wire that snapped the moment I touched it. Since the assembly had seen better days, I did a full refresh; swapping out the heater cartridge, thermistor, heater block, and heatbreak. It's now running like new again.
